proof_body:
by
  intro u U c hU hp hc hu hmax
  set V := {z | z ∈ U ∧ u z = u c} with hV
  have hlocal : ∀ x ∈ V, ∃ ε > 0, Metric.ball x ε ⊆ V := by
    rintro x ⟨hxU, hxc⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hxU
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
    have hh : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (Metric.ball x ε) := hu.mono hsub
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hre⟩ := hh.exists_analyticOnNhd_ball_re_eq
    have hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball x ε) := hF.differentiableOn
    have hG : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Complex.exp (F z)) (Metric.ball x ε) := hFd.cexp
    have hxm : x ∈ Metric.ball x ε := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
    have hm : IsMaxOn (norm ∘ fun z => Complex.exp (F z)) (Metric.ball x ε) x := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Function.comp_apply, Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have e1 : (F z).re = u z := hre hz
      have e2 : (F x).re = u x := hre hxm
      rw [e1, e2, hxc]
      exact hmax z (hsub hz)
    have he := Complex.eqOn_of_isPreconnected_of_isMaxOn_norm (convex_ball x ε).isPreconnected Metric.isOpen_ball hG hxm hm
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨hsub hz, ?_⟩
    have h1 := congrArg norm (he hz)
    simp only [Function.const_apply, Complex.norm_exp] at h1
    have h2 := Real.exp_injective h1
    have e1 : (F z).re = u z := hre hz
    have e2 : (F x).re = u x := hre hxm
    rw [← e1, h2, e2, hxc]
  have hVo : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_iff.mpr hlocal
  have hsub := hp.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hVo ⟨c, hc, hc, rfl⟩ (by
    rintro z ⟨hzcl, hzU⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousAt u z := (hu z hzU).1.continuousAt
    refine ⟨hzU, ?_⟩
    by_contra hne
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in nhds z, u y ≠ u c := hcont.eventually_ne hne
    obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.mp hzcl _ hev
    exact hy1 hy2.2)
  exact fun z hz => (hsub hz).2
target_source: ∀ (u : ℂ → ℝ) (U : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → c ∈ U → InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u U → (∀ z ∈ U, u z ≤ u c) → ∀ z ∈ U, u z = u c
